label: Pregnant adult characters — IMDb keyword follow-up (25 Oct 2026)
description: Follow-up to the pregnant sex / intimate sweep. Adult, pregnant female characters in sex or intimate scenes; a title is added only when confirmed by two sources beyond an IMDb keyword. Existing cards enriched with partner and outcome. Plot-level notes only.

records.title: Gourmet (Nikoline music video)
records.meta: Music video · Denmark · Danish · directed by Nikoline
records.fit_note: Music video: the pregnancy scene is an erotic dance and nudity rather than a plotted love scene. Pregnancy is real (actress heavily pregnant when filmed).
records.summary: In Nikoline's mythology-themed video the heavily pregnant Aphrodite performs an erotic, serpentine dance up against Adonis amid a nude ensemble; Danish press covers the pregnant casting and the sexual content.
records.pregnancy_outcome: Performer had given birth by the time of the press coverage (Ekko, June 2020)
records.evidence: Multi-source (Information, Ekko, DR); video itself not viewed
